title: Building Mundra port against the incumbents
statement: Adani developed Mundra on the Gujarat coast as a private deep-draft port, competing with the state-owned major ports in an industry private capital had never cracked.
outcome: Mundra became India's largest private port and the anchor of the Adani conglomerate's infrastructure platform, generating the cash and credibility for everything after.

title: Carmichael coal mine — the contested Australia bet
statement: Adani committed to the giant Queensland coal basin, holding through years of environmental litigation and activist pressure that made Carmichael the world's most contested mining project.
outcome: First coal shipped in 2021; the mine's economics and Adani's resolve were both proven, though the project became the emblem of climate activism's power over finance.

title: Surviving the Hindenburg short
statement: When Hindenburg Research's report alleging accounting manipulation erased roughly $100 billion of Adani group market value, Adani rallied institutional support, paid down pledge-linked debt, and refused to dilute control at the bottom.
outcome: Shares recovered most of the loss over the following year; the group refinanced, completed key projects, and a Supreme Court expert committee found no conclusive regulatory failure — though the episode permanently raised the conglomerate's scrutiny.
